description: We are JARFYN FIRE, a team of six university students studying Software, Systems, and Industrial Engineering. Participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aim to develop an innovative solution for harmonizing MODIS and VIIRS hotspot data. Combining technology, data analysis, and creativity, we strive to turn satellite data into meaningful insights for better environmental monitoring. Our team is complete, and we are ready to collaborate, learn, and make an impact!
